parameters.description: Required for this mutation. Reuse with the identical request returns the cached original result for 24 hours.

slot_id.description: Canonical server-generated slot identifier returned as slots[].id by GET /api/v1/care/doctors/{id}/slots. It currently equals slots[].start.

payment_method_id.description: Cash only in the currently implemented bridge. Other payment method identifiers fail with payment_method_not_supported; card intent and temporary payment holds are not implemented.

201.description: Created or rescheduled cash consultation booking.

idempotent_replay.description: Present and true only on replay.

400.description: Invalid body, unavailable arbitrary slot id, or unsupported payment method.

409.description: The server-generated slot is already taken.
